title: Let the deeper fear swallow the lesser ones
summary: Naam absorbs the heart so deeply that lesser fears are forgotten. Let reverence and taste become larger than the anxieties asking to govern you.
takeaway: Let Naam become larger than the fears competing for command.
lifeApplication: When worries multiply, stay with the Naam until at least one lesser fear loses the right to lead your next action.

source.shortMeaning: Those who drink the nectar of the Unspoken are absorbed in Naam, and other fears are forgotten.
source.lifeApplication: When fear multiplies, stay with the line until the smaller ones begin to thin.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad does not deny fear; it shows lesser fears being swallowed by absorption in Naam.
evidence.turn: Taste Naam deeply enough that lesser fears stop governing you.
evidence.practicalImplication: When worries multiply, stay with the Naam until at least one lesser fear loses the right to lead your next action.
